about: InDesign 2025 live corners measured with real mouse input (artifacts/liveinput-c1-20261023, tools/lclab.py, tools/make_measured.py). drags: a diamond pressed where it stood and dragged from_px to to_px (screen px, 1 px = pt_per_px pt; coarse = a path of 13 events or fewer, which InDesign follows loosely); before/after = [shape, radius] of TL, TR, BL, BR as the DOM reads them; corner: 0 top left, 1 top right, 2 bottom left, 3 bottom right. cycles: one Alt press during a press-and-release on a diamond.
